learning_tasks.title: Learn LangChain Tool Calling
learning_tasks.description: Learn how to define tools, expose them to an LLM, validate tool arguments, and execute tool calls.

learning_tasks.title: Learn LangGraph State and Nodes
learning_tasks.description: Learn how to build stateful workflows using LangGraph nodes, edges, conditional routing, and shared state.

learning_tasks.title: Build Multi-Step Agent Workflow
learning_tasks.description: Implement a multi-step workflow that retrieves information, reasons over it, selects tools, executes actions, and records the result.

learning_tasks.title: Learn Agent Planning Patterns
learning_tasks.description: Study planning, tool selection, state management, reasoning-before-action, and human approval patterns for AI agents.

learning_tasks.title: Improve Retrieval Quality
learning_tasks.description: Study chunking strategies, metadata filtering, semantic retrieval, and evidence-based answer generation.

learning_tasks.title: Practice PostgreSQL for Backend Applications
learning_tasks.description: Practice relational schema design, joins, filtering, indexing, and PostgreSQL integration with Python applications.

learning_tasks.title: Learn Production Docker Workflows
learning_tasks.description: Practice Dockerfiles, containerized FastAPI services, environment configuration, and local multi-service development.

learning_tasks.title: Build Production-Ready FastAPI APIs
learning_tasks.description: Practice dependency injection, validation, error handling, API organization, and deployment patterns.
